items.newText: WashU provides students, faculty, and staff with secure enterprise AI tools approved for general university and FERPA data, but restricts Protected Health Information (PHI) use to specific approved tools (Gemini, Claude Secure, ChatGPT Edu, Ask WashU), while Gemini Notebook, Claude Edu, Copilot Chat, and developer coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot) are explicitly not approved for WashU PHI.
